info.title: Cadence API
info.description: Existing MVP API. OWNER only; EDITOR/VIEWER reserved. Explicit Bearer header only, no cookie sessions. Workspace/brand routes reject scope violations with 403; Job polling conceals unsupported/foreign ids with 404. JSON timestamps are UTC with Z suffix. Error code and status are stable; English title/detail are display text. Secrets, payloads and internal keys are excluded. Every response has a server-generated X-Request-ID UUID (client values ignored). Process-local account rate limits may return 429 request_rate_exceeded with Retry-After:60; concurrency admission may return 503 with Retry-After:1. These technical demo limits do not replace durable budgets, current access checks or deployment edge controls.
